notes: The vault a TRON deployment uses is built by TRON's own compiler, and every hash a deployment pins comes from that build. `python3 scripts/tron/build_vault_tron_solc.py --solc PATH` reproduces it and compares; `tron_deploy.py` refuses any other creation code on TRON mainnet. The forge build (stock solc 0.8.24, creation 24,288 bytes, sha256 22402ad300000150ac82bec9962ea1c30b7ab7e693e6d81bb29a76214226f4a8) is for the forge suites only. UNAUDITED.

compiler.sha256Source: equal to the line for solc-static-linux in the release's own shasum.txt, downloaded with it on 2026-11-17; the release's PGP signature file (solc-static-linux.sig) was downloaded and NOT verified: no trusted copy of the signing key was at hand
